summary: Bind staged Helm charts to their exact release candidate and reject failed artifact comparisons before signing or promotion.
userImpact: Release candidates cannot silently reuse a different chart payload staged for an earlier candidate.
configuration: Candidate chart repositories are scoped by the verified full source revision; public chart names and semantic versions remain unchanged.
security: Artifact lookup, comparison, transfer, and digest failures propagate through shell command substitutions. Protected chart consumers require the exact receipt-bound candidate repository.
knownLimitations: Live signing and protected registry promotion remain acceptance checks in the authorized release pipeline.
New source-scoped consumers reject legacy unscoped signed candidate charts; historical recovery requires the matching protected workflow and source.
rollback: Do not overwrite an immutable candidate or public semantic tag. Correct a changed payload through a newly qualified candidate or forward release.
validation: 134 CI-contract tests passed, including 48 candidate cases with actual shell and archive comparison regressions; 66 classifier tests, release-note and documentation guards, and workflow lint passed on supported Node 24.15. Live publication and signing were not performed by these local checks.
